S1.instruction: Select Garden; search lamp; expect zero cards and correct empty/count state.
Clear folder; search small tools; expect only An unfinished thought. Toggle archived and confirm filters still apply.
Delay an older /api/notes request in browser tooling, issue a newer query, and release responses out of order. Newer results must remain.
Exercise keyboard focus, folder/search controls, archive, and 390px layout. No new blocking regression.

S2.instruction: Import a valid two-note file from the visible control; verify counts, rendered notes, and persistence after reload.
Try malformed JSON, a valid first entry followed by an invalid entry, then select the same corrected file again. Failure is clear, nothing partially imports, retry works.
Delay the import response and attempt another submission. Busy feedback is visible and duplicate submission is prevented.
Abort/fail the import request. Do not show success; keep existing notes/view and allow retry.
Import a title/body containing HTML-like text. It must display as text without creating executable elements.
Use import and feedback by keyboard; inspect accessible labels/status announcements and layout at 390px.

S3.instruction: Archive using keyboard, observe clear nonmodal feedback, and undo within 10 seconds. The restored note and useful focus are present.
Let the 10-second window expire. Undo is no longer offered as available; no false success message.
Archive and reload promptly. A working Undo is still available for the remaining time.
Archive two notes rapidly. Feedback and Undo refer to the second; the first remains archived.
Fail archive and undo requests separately. Feedback is understandable and view matches confirmed server state.
Search/folder state is preserved across archive/undo. Exercise at 390px; inspect keyboard access, focus destination, and screen-reader announcement semantics.
